paper_threshold.stated_text: fold change > +-1.5, p-value < 0.05, and adjusted p-value (FDR) < 0.1%

paper_method: Partek Flow 5.0: STAR + Cufflinks FPKM on hg38 RefSeq; per-gene multimodel (normal/lognormal/lognormal-shrinkage/NB/Poisson) chosen by AICc (S2.5.1.p1)
paper_results: No exercise DEGs in either group at any day (Table 3); 19 unique disease/subset DEGs, mostly low-coverage false positives (S3.3.p2, TAB4)
